name: Runic Kiln
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished pixel-art prototype sheet for a Core Keeper connected storage mod. One matching terminal and sealed storage node pair, not ordinary hinged chests. Native-game-compatible small tile prop design: top-down three-quarter view showing top and front, square pixel clusters, restrained roughly 24x24 logical pixels per prop, crisp nearest-neighbor enlarged presentation, limited palette, dark colored outlines, upper-left highlights, no smooth illustration or 3D rendering. Show two large isolated designs above and a small example of one terminal connected edge-to-edge to three nodes on simple cave floor tiles below. Plain dark charcoal background, generous spacing. Labels Terminal and Storage node. These are concept prototypes, prioritize readable silhouettes at tiny size. Theme RUNIC KILN: ancient dwarven ceramics and iron. Terminal is a squat angled ochre clay rune console with a recessed amber glass dial and two chunky keys, iron feet. Storage node is a sealed squat hexagonal-looking clay vessel on a square iron base, three amber slits and dark iron compression bands. Warm terracotta, charcoal iron, honey amber. Industrial ancient pottery, no cyan, no modern screen.
